sourceSentences: Enemies cannot see the location of the cast for the first second, but they can already tell that the spell is underway by noticing Volibear's cast animation.
Volibear can cast Sky Splitter during the movement speed boost from Thundering Smash to prevent the animation from playing.
If Volibear becomes immobilize [immobilized] or polymorph [polymorphed] by an enemy during Thundering Smash, the effect ends prematurely and the cooldown is reset.
Thundering Smash basic attack reset [resets] Volibear's basic attack timer.

Thundering Smash's attack does not put Volibear's basic attack on cooldown. This results in the same functionality as Shield of Daybreak [Leona] and Emberstrike [Shyvana], effectively being a double attack reset.
dash [pounce] on the target [to 25 to 150 units closer than attack range], dealing bonus physical damage and stun [stunning] them for 1 second.
Volibear dash [leaps] over 1 second regardless of distance or movement speed.
Frenzied Maul's bite heals even if it is blocked by spell shield.
Frenzied Maul deals bonus damage and heals if the target is still Wounded after the cast time.
Volibear will receive the shield even if he is untargetable.
If Volibear is within the strike, he gains a shield equal to 14% of his maximum health (+ 75% AP) for 3 seconds.
Volibear also disables enemy turrets in an area for a duration, rendering them unable to attack. Turret Disable Duration [2 to 4 seconds]
Disabling a turret does not prevent aggro of the current target it is locked onto.
Turrets maintain the same targeting behavior even when disabled; damaging an enemy champion will still draw turret aggro.

Whenever Volibear damages at least one enemy with a basic attack or ability, he generates a stack of The Relentless Storm for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent damage and stacking up to 5 times.
chaining up to 4 subsequent targets.

your Q is the animation cancel, your W is animation cancel, right?

it resets if you get stunned while you're down on all fours.
you can use your Q to go through a wall. If an enemy is hugged up against a thin wall, you can use your Q on them with your auto-attack range
